signals.text: Arsenal hold off energetic Sunderland to continue perfect title defence . Arsenal maintain their 100% start to their Premier League season with a win at Sunderland, who mount an admirable push for a point before Bukayo Saka's penalty puts the result beyond doubt.
Guimaraes and Raya crucial - Sunderland v Arsenal player ratings. How Sunderland and Arsenal players rated following their Premier League match.
Emery left searching for answers after another Villa loss. Aston Villa have lost three of their opening four Premier League games to leave boss Unai Emery struggling for answers.
Arsenal monitoring Como's Paz - Sunday's gossip. Arsenal are monitoring Nico Paz, Liverpool and Aston Villa are tracking Cher Ndour and Sunderland are refusing to give up on Geny Catamo, plus more.

'A clear red card' - Emery berates VAR as Villa lose late to Forest. Aston Villa manager Unai Emery was left frustrated with the match officials after they chose to not send off Nottingham Forest's James McAtee, following a challenge on Ian Maatsen which left the defender injured and meant Villa had to play the closing stages of the match with 10 men, with Forest taking advantage, scoring late to win 2-1 at Villa Park.

Chelsea's defence looks 'weak & disjointed' - analysis. Match of the Day pundit Ashley Williams says Chelsea's "struggling" defence looked "weak and disjointed" in their 2-2 draw against Hull at Stamford Bridge.
Solanke struggles, but Branthwaite solid - Spurs v Everton player ratings. How Spurs and Everton's players rated following their Premier League match, which ended in a goalless draw.
